excluded_from_x.abstract_v1: Raw text; used only through TF-IDF.
excluded_from_x.authors_v1_json: Identity metadata; author_count_v1 is the model feature.
excluded_from_x.comment_v1: Optional venue/status metadata; possible post-t0 information.
excluded_from_x.cs_categories_v1_json: Redundant with primary_category_v1 for this baseline.
excluded_from_x.dblp_previously_published_before_arxiv_v: DBLP audit field; not a baseline predictor.
excluded_from_x.doi_v1: Identifier/optional metadata; not predictive at t0.
excluded_from_x.journal_ref_v1: Optional venue metadata; not part of the t0 content/team feature set.
excluded_from_x.s2_reference_count_current: Current-time metadata; post-t0 and therefore leakage-prone.
excluded_from_x.t0_date: Time key used to construct the split; not a content feature.
excluded_from_x.title_v1: Raw text; used only through TF-IDF.
